title: D2SA two-stage synthetic MRI test-time adaptation with Mirror-only compact state

prior_art.paper: D2SA: Dual-Stage Distribution and Slice Adaptation for Efficient Test-Time Adaptation in MRI Reconstruction
prior_art.source_observation: Official code is available and documents batch patient-wise adaptation of a SIREN prompt plus per-slice latent vectors followed by single-slice DEBlock refinement. The README states the required pretrained knee/brain checkpoints and MRI data are not included and must be obtained via the upstream project. The official path depends on upstream U-Net code and CUDA-oriented MRI packages/checkpoints not installed here.

hypothesis: On a controlled synthetic MRI anatomy shift, a shared distribution coordinate plus a compact per-slice Givens view can retain self-supervised D2SA-style TTA quality within 1% of ordinary two-stage FiLM adaptation while reducing complete per-volume adaptation-state bytes by at least 25% and not increasing online updates.
scope: Bounded mechanism screen, not a reproduction or clinical evaluation of D2SA. Synthetic 32x32 single-coil complex phantoms and an independently implemented small reconstructor because official training assets are absent.

model.shared_object: small shared 4-channel latent MRI prior and measurement operator
model.coordinate: volume-level and slice-level coordinates inserted in the 4-channel latent feature map
model.native_control: ordinary affine FiLM scale/bias coordinates with identical two-stage self-supervised adaptation objective
model.mirror: two volume-level plus two slice-level Givens angles conjugating the same latent regularizer

data.type: analytic synthetic complex MRI phantoms; no acquired MRI
data.test_time_reference_policy: Fully sampled target images are used only for post-adaptation scoring; TTA receives only disjoint measured k-space partitions.

controls: native D2SA-style two-stage adaptation using shared FiLM distribution parameters and ordinary per-slice FiLM codes
same prior and update budget with volume and slice Givens Mirror coordinates
independent per-slice last-layer adaptation upper control

training.pretraining: supervised source-domain phantom training, fixed schedule
training.adaptation: split acquired samples into disjoint optimization and heldout scoring masks; no target reference in the loss
training.stage_one: shared volume adaptation on four support slices
training.stage_two: per-slice adaptation on eight development slices
training.updates: 12 updates per stage and case for all trainable-code methods
training.selection: fixed one-shot screen; no fresh-set access and no hyperparameter selection

metrics: actual serialized full per-volume payload bytes

storage.authority: actual serialized inference/TTA state payload bytes
paid: all per-volume distribution and slice codes
optimizer state excluded from inference payload but separately reported as transient adaptation memory
storage.common_schema: All alternatives are serialized with identical architecture and acquisition metadata keys.

success_gate: Development Mirror meets the registered hypothesis only if it is within 1% relative NMSE of native FiLM adaptation, saves at least 25% complete per-volume state bytes, and uses no more TTA updates; a PASS would still require fresh sealed seeds.
failure_gate: FAIL if Mirror is >1% relatively worse than native adaptation, fails heldout measurement consistency, provides <25% byte savings, is dominated by a byte-near ordinary code control, or requires more updates.
boundaries: No acquired MRI or clinical claim.
Not an exact D2SA implementation/reproduction; official D2SA checkpoints and upstream training assets are absent.
Single-coil, small synthetic problem cannot establish performance on multi-coil real anatomy, scanner shifts, or clinical TTA.
Synthetic ground truth is used for scoring only, never for target adaptation.
failure_gate_result: FAIL at the frozen development gate: Mirror saves only 192 B (3.25%) vs ordinary two-stage FiLM, below the 25% requirement; it also has higher NMSE than frozen sharing and independent per-slice adaptation. Fresh seeds remain unopened.

compute.tta_forward_mac_proxy: 74,317,824 CNN MAC across 144 support+slice update predictions per code method; backward pass and FFT costs additionally incurred. Independent control: 49,544,? CNN MAC proxy across 96 predictions.
compute.fft: one forward FFT prediction per TTA update; heldout residual scoring adds 8 FFT calls per method
compute.wall: pretraining and TTA wall time measured separately in runs/development.json
compute.active_compute_proxy: 74,317,824 CNN forward MAC across 144 support+slice update predictions per code method; backward pass and FFT costs additionally incurred. Independent control: 49,545,216 CNN forward MAC across 96 predictions.
